action_items: None. All 13 review criteria for AI Home v7 dashboard pass. The iter_21 regressions (fake weekly charts, FAB overlap, SPL Y-tick suppression) are all fixed. Shippable.
critical_code_review_comments: ai-home/index.tsx L79 — onObjective auto-calls loadDemoVenue() for any non-'design' objective on empty state. This is intentional (helps users see the dashboard) but means clicking optimize/live/diagnose/report from empty state now persists demo data across the session. Documented in iter_20 already — not a regression.

system-vitals.ts L98 — headroomDb = max(0, arraySpl-105). With demo data (152 dB array), headroom shows 47 dB which is technically true but unrealistic for a real venue (105 dB target is conservative). Consider capping display value at 12 dB (since the progress bar width uses (headroom/12)*100 clamped at 100). Not blocking; the progress bar clamps correctly.

system-vitals.ts L96 — arraySpl uses 20·log10(N) for array gain, which is the coherent-source limit. For real full-range PA arrays 10·log10(N) is more accurate. Acceptable for a dashboard headline; consider adding a footnote in future iterations.

ai-home/index.tsx L48-62 — useMemo dep list includes tops/subs/monitors/amps arrays whose identity changes on every store mutation. This is fine at current scale but could cause chart re-renders during heavy edit sessions. Consider memoizing at store level via zustand computed if it becomes an issue.

charts.tsx L48-50 — YAxis has interval={0} + domain={[min, max]} when yTicks is provided. This is the correct recharts pattern to force all ticks to render, and it demonstrably fixes the iter_21 '100 tick missing' bug.
